picks.title: Taking on CUDA with ROCm: 'One Step After Another'
picks.why_it_matters: AMD's ROCm progress signals a potential opening in the GPU compute stack, which could create opportunities for startups building AI infrastructure tools that aren't locked into NVIDIA's ecosystem.

picks.title: Exploiting the most prominent AI agent benchmarks
picks.why_it_matters: Flawed AI agent benchmarks expose a gap in reliable evaluation tooling—a potential opportunity for startups building trusted testing and validation infrastructure as enterprises demand accountability from AI deployments.

picks.title: Apple's accidental moat: How the 'AI Loser' may end up winning
